title: OpenAI made Codex mobile 🤯 Control your computer from your phone. Syncs across devices. #OpenAI
description:
OpenAI just dropped a major Codex update: now you can control the app on your computer прямо from your phone. 🚀  

Use Codex to kick off workflows, check Slack, draft emails, and manage tasks anywhere — not just for developers. Everything syncs across devices, so you can keep working from your phone, laptop, or wherever you are.
